text: Over the last 30 days, all visitor reviews for the Theodore Roosevelt Presidential Library have been positive, with an average rating of 5.0 and no critical feedback. However, comments related to food quality and wait times appeared in all three reviews, indicating these areas are frequently mentioned by visitors. Service was noted in two reviews, and atmosphere was mentioned once. While no specific issues were raised, the consistent focus on food and wait times suggests these aspects may warrant ongoing attention.

windows.60: Over the last 60 days, visitor reviews have highlighted ongoing issues with the food service at the Theodore Roosevelt Presidential Library. Several guests reported long wait times and inconsistent availability of menu items, with some noting that the kitchen was backed up and orders were not being taken for extended periods. The menu options were described as limited and not meeting expectations in terms of quality or variety. While the overall rating remains above 4, these service and food quality concerns have been the main sources of dissatisfaction. Addressing these operational challenges could improve the visitor experience.
windows.90: Visitor reviews over the last 90 days show consistent concerns about the food service at the Theodore Roosevelt Presidential Library. Many found the menu limited and the food quality below expectations, with complaints about portion sizes, taste, and pricing. Several reviewers noted long wait times and issues with kitchen delays, sometimes resulting in only grab-and-go options being available late in the day. While the library itself receives positive remarks, the café’s menu, pricing, and service logistics appear to need significant improvement.
